Hi Amy,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through CloudPulse's objectives for a controlled pilot. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

1) What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for real-time analytics pipelines; target P95 < 120ms for 1.5k QPS.
- Must-haves: SSO (SAML/OIDC), data segregation, and audit logs for the pilot.
- Procurement: CloudPulse prefers a 90-day pilot with a PO if results align.

2) Proposed next meeting
- Technical deep dive + demo (45–60m) where we show a trimmed pilot run and SSO walkthrough.
- Suggested windows (PST):
  • Tue 2026-11-23 10:00–11:00 or
  • Wed 2026-11-24 14:00–15:00
If neither works, happy to coordinate via your scheduling tool — I pasted a Calendly link below.

3) Who to include
- Please include whoever owns procurement (PO/contract) and your platform/security lead for the SSO questions. I looped in our security lead, Soojin, on this thread. For procurement/PO coordination I'll bring in Karthik (cc'ed on follow-up).

4) Attachments & links
- Attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (quick cadence + responsibilities)
- Demo agenda link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_demo_materials

Let me know which time works or share a couple of alternatives. If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite that includes Soojin and Karthik.

Thanks,
